root.label: Daniel Flores submits complaint to LAPD

events.label: Daniel Flores submits complaint to LAPD

slots.name: complaint date
slots.sentence: In January 2025, he submitted his complaint to the Los Angeles police commission and the department’s internal affairs unit.

slots.name: internal investigation status
slots.sentence: After The Los Angeles Times reported on the recordings last year, the Police Department opened an internal investigation, and the taped remarks were denounced across the board by city leaders.

slots.name: personnel investigation status
slots.sentence: The city’s personnel department opened an investigation into the case’s possible impact on police recruitment, and officials said at the time that several members of Officer Flores’s unit had been ordered to stay at home pending completion of the investigation.

slots.name: administrative investigation status
slots.sentence: The department also opened a separate administrative investigation into Officer Flores over possible policy violations.
